name: Men's Class B blue long-sleeve shirt, tie and trousers (nametag position only)
size_basis: Silhouette (long sleeves, collar, torso, trousers/skirt) measured from CAPR 39-1 Figure 4.8 (3 March 2020): the figure was rendered at 2.2x, traced, and scaled with the registration of its short-sleeve twin to the short-sleeve base image, so interior parts line up with garment-blues-class-b-shirt-male. No real garment was measured.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h}; polygons are [[x,y]...]; all in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left of the artwork box
documented: light blue long-sleeve shirt, two pleated pockets, convertible cuffs, epaulets (CAPR 39-1 4.1.11.1.1)
long sleeves end 1/4 to 1/2 in below the wrist (4.1.11.1.1)
tie: the tip covers a portion of the belt buckle but does not extend below it (4.1.8.3, as for the other men's blues)
nameplate centred on, resting on (not over) the top edge of the wearer's right pocket (4.1.11.1.1.2.1)
cadet NCOs/airmen: metal chevrons on both sides of the collar, 1 in from and parallel to the front of the collar (4.1.11.1.1.1.4)
assumed: nameplate size (3.375 x 0.75 in = Vanguard CAP0599M cadet name plate (blue plastic, 3 3/8 x 3/4 in); no dimension in CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903; no dimension in CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903)
